upstream_identity_policy: Registry identities include the canonical registry source and checksum; a missing checksum remains explicit.
Git identities include a normalized URL and immutable revision.
Repository URLs are normalized by scheme, host case, trailing slash, and .git suffix.
Missing repository metadata falls back to a source-derived identity or unknown:<package-id>; unrelated unknowns are never merged.
native_evidence_policy: Cargo resolution alone never proves native compilation.
active requires a package-specific build.rs or emitted-link rule recorded by the generator.
declared-inactive records a known native declaration whose activating edge is absent; signal-hook -> cc is a regression fixture.
unknown is fail-closed for an unclassified custom-build package and is never reported as safe.
methodology: Each baseline uses a synthesized out-of-workspace consumer or a shadow of every workspace member manifest with inert targets.
Every active direct root edge is removed from a second valid manifest and cargo metadata resolves the counterfactual independently.
The repository Cargo.lock seeds each baseline; the resolved baseline lock seeds its offline counterfactuals.
Package IDs, not package-name text, define graph reachability and marginal sets.
Build dependencies and proc macros execute in host context even during cross-target resolution.
First-party path packages and the synthetic roots are excluded explicitly; external path packages remain fail-closed.
no_claim_boundaries: The ledger measures Cargo resolution, not compilation, runtime correctness, performance, release readiness, or exploitability.
Native active/declared-inactive/unknown evidence is an attribution receipt, not a safety certification.
Individual-edge marginals do not equal an exact simultaneous multi-edge removal forecast; phase forecasts are bounded generated estimates.
A taxonomy reference records review obligations and does not authorize implementation or cutover.
